body.p: After and . The part registries were global, so the core sxml.wasm linked XQuery's lowering parts (about 75 KB, ) and the XSLT-only library and evaluator parts ().

item.p: Owns: cmake/SxmlParts.cmake, the registry lines of CMakeLists.txt, the registry declarations in src/function_library_parts_internal.h, src/xpath_lower_internal.h and src/evaluator_machine_internal.h, single hunks where each language names its lists, tests/part_registry_test.c, the size baseline.

Done when: one mechanism makes a module link only the parts of the languages it offers; the core drops the XQuery-only and XSLT-only parts while the full module, the CLI and native builds keep them; whole release QT4 and XT40 runs unchanged; 's baseline refreshed. Done 2026-10-19 (): one list per language and registry, generated by the glob and named by the language's entry point; units carry their language's evaluator parts; sxml.wasm 2,215,004 / 774,905 to 2,094,214 / 731,897 (lowering and library, at 5385a0e) and 2,101,275 / 734,951 to 2,077,439 / 725,473 (evaluator_stream and evaluator_template, at 5664da8); QT4 and XT40 unchanged.
